setting: You four are dog walkers who meet at a local off-leash park in Perth, Australia, where you have known each other for a couple of years from early-morning walks. You use this group chat to swap walk schedules when someone is sick or away, and to flag which dogs are fussy about other dogs that day.
openers: Send a photo of Biscuit at the off-leash area
Ask who can cover Thursday's 7am walk
Check if anyone can take the spaniel on Saturday
Post a reminder to bring water bowls today

text: Reminder to bring water bowls today supposed to hit 34 by 11
on it 💧💧 i have the big collapsible one
Yes, I'll bring the steel bowl.
Got them. Bowl for Biscuit's bag too.
Ta 👍
Ruby's off other dogs today btw. Keep her away from the staffy at the north gate, she had a go at him Friday 🙄
Noted. Thank you.
ngl the staffy is the problem 😭 but noted
shift ran over and im stuck at the café till 4. cant do the 3 o'clock walk for the Hendersons 😩 anyone
I can take it. Job finishes around 2.
ur a legend simon ill text the Hendersons
I'll confirm with the Hendersons too in case they've changed the time. Simon, can you pick up their lead from the boot? It's in the blue bag.
Yes
Anyone heard from Chris about the Bramwell dogs? Nobody's answering on his number
He had a fall on Friday, I think. Ask Tanya at the vet clinic. She'd know.
Ok will try her. Thanks Joan
anyone watching the match tonight
Not me, got a 7am inspection tomorrow 😴
who won fell asleep on the couch
nvm found it. ugh
Tanya says Chris is in Fiona Stanley with a broken hip. Dogs are with his sister in Kardinya
Oh dear. Poor man.
Did she say how long
No, didn't say. Probably weeks. I'll see if the sister wants help
i can do the bramwell walks if they need it, just send me the times
Chris's walks were 7:15 and 4. Ask the sister before you take anything on, Noah. She may want the Kardinya set left alone for a bit.
yep ok 👍
Hendersons, Simon. Did the walk go alright?
Yes. Their dog found a tennis ball in the bushes near the lake and wouldn't give it up. Lead's back in the boot.
Thank you.
Ruby's still off other dogs till Friday. Not the staffy, not anyone. She's grumpy
poor ruby tell her the staffy is a menace
shift done thank god. anyone doing the 4 o'clock bramwell walk or is that just me now
Waiting to hear from the sister. I'll tell you once I do.
Sister says she'd rather keep the dogs at her place this week. She'll ring anyone who needs to pick up a lead.
Ok good. Glad someone's got them
match was a bloodbath lol. can't believe that last 10 mins
Didn't see it, sorry. Heard the neighbours yelling though 😂
morning. anyone doing bramwell 7:15 or do i go?
Sister rang me last night. The lead and bags are at her place in Kardinya. Nobody is to go to Chris's house. I'll ring her again at nine.
ok so i can still do the 7:15? or no
Pipe's gone in a unit on Stirling Hwy. Could be a while. Can't do the 4 yet.
I'll take the 4 if nobody else has it 👍 open home finishes 3:30 so might be a bit late
i'll take the 4 then lauren. 7:15 is the one i cant do, shift starts 6
So who's the 7:15 🤔
Sister says she'll walk them herself until Chris is home. She'd like us to leave them be for now.
Ok good. So no walks needed?
Not for now. She'll ring if that changes.
its 36 out here already. dogs need water!! lots of it
Saw that, thanks. Hot one
Stirling Hwy done. Going home to shower.
4 o clock done. biscuit tried to eat a whole crust someone dropped by the bench
Did he get it out of him?
yeah it was fine. he looked guilty tho
The Hendersons want Friday moved to 8. Simon, can you take it?
Yes.
anyone know if the fire ban is on for the park this week
nvm checked the council site. no ban 👍
